_comment: D2 item 7: a link to a missing FILE whose name holds `#` reads as its name (or alias) as text on both lanes, never a pending link to a note `report`. Live audit 2026-11-03 (F3): an EMBED of a missing file is a not-found notice on both lanes, named by the full `#` name. The embed's `missing` ref is what the plugin sends (Plan C Task 8 `classifyRef`, the name read like `_unresolved_bare_target`). The two LINKS carry no ref here, to pin the no-ref text reading; a real plugin also sends them as `missing` refs, which the live lane shows as notices while the client keeps the text (a lane difference outside F3).
